select p.name, sum(r.amount_cents) / 100 as deposit_usd
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
where r.type = 1 and r.status = 2
group by p.name;

select p.name as name,
       sum(r.amount_cents) / 100 as deposit_usd
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
where r.type = 1
  and r.status = 2
group by p.name;

select a.agent_name, count(*) as sessions
from app.sessions s
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = try_cast(s.playerid as bigint)
join crm.agents a on a.code = p.agent_code
group by a.agent_name;

select
    a.agent_name,
    count(*) as sessions
from crm.agents a
join crm.player_accounts pa on pa.agent_code = a.code
join app.sessions s on cast(s.playerid as bigint) = pa.id
group by a.agent_name

select g.title, sum(b.stake_cents) / 100.0 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.games g on g.code = b.game_code
group by g.title;

select g.title, sum(b.stake_cents) / 100 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.games g on g.code = b.game_code
group by g.title;

select p.country,
       count(*) as rejected_withdrawals
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts p on p.id = r.user_ref
where r.type = 2 and r.status = 3
group by p.country;

select pa.country, count(*) as rejected_withdrawals
from fin.requests r
join crm.player_accounts pa on pa.id = r.user_ref
where r.type = 2 and r.status = 3
group by pa.country
order by rejected_withdrawals desc

select count(*) as players
from (select distinct cast(playerid as bigint) as pid from app.sessions) s
join (select distinct member_ref as pid from game.bets) b using (pid)

select count(distinct t1.id) as players
from crm.player_accounts t1
join app.sessions t0 on t1.id = cast(t0.playerid as bigint)
join game.bets t2 on t2.member_ref = t1.id;
